contract.purpose: CodeVetter helps developers verify agent-authored changes through reproducible execution evidence and exact source navigation.
contract.purposeSource: PRODUCT.md; owner PRD in GitHub issue #285
contract.canonicalPurpose: CodeVetter determines whether a coding agent completed a software task correctly using reproducible execution evidence.
contract.audience: Developers and technical owners reviewing agent changes in unfamiliar repositories
contract.job: Paste a GitHub URL, inspect exact source or diff, follow architecture and evidence locations
contract.thesis: Preserve the Evidence Bench and put pinned source at the center of a compact native workbench
contract.system: Existing true-black/light native palette, bronze focus, 12-point monospace source, hairline pane separators, compact native controls
contract.signature: Persistent commit and blob identity connect every source window to its evidence
contract.risk: A dedicated AppKit source plane trades editor features for bounded viewport rendering; keep it read-only and qualify accessibility separately
